description: This file defines an Android activity 'AttractionsActivity' that displays a UI for nearby attractions using a grid view pager on a wearable device. It handles data fetching via Google APIs, manages user interactions like long presses to dismiss, and updates the UI with attraction data loaded asynchronously.

classes.name: AttractionsActivity
classes.description: Main wearable activity for displaying nearby attractions in a grid view pager with gesture and data handling logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI components, sets window insets, and starts data fetching if a data URI is provided.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Intercepts touch events to detect gestures using a gesture detector.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, passing them to the gesture detector.

methods.name: onChromeFadeIn
methods.description: Callback to fade in the UI chrome elements, specifically the dots page indicator.

methods.name: onChromeFadeOut
methods.description: Callback to fade out the UI chrome elements.

methods.name: LongPressListener
methods.description: Detects long press gestures to show a dismiss overlay.

methods.name: FetchDataAsyncTask
methods.description: Async task that connects to Google API, fetches attraction data, loads images, and updates UI.
